mapper.select:
select p.id, p.name, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.description, p.status, (select count(1) from favorite f where (f.target_type = 'poi' and f.target_id = p.id) or (f.target_type = 'media' and exists (select 1 from media fm where fm.id = f.target_id and fm.poi_id = p.id))) as favorite_count, (select count(1) from `comment` c where (c.target_type = 'poi' and c.target_id = p.id) or (c.target_type = 'media' and exists (select 1 from media cm where cm.id = c.target_id and cm.poi_id = p.id))) as comment_count, (select count(1) from `comment` c where ((c.target_type = 'poi' and c.target_id = p.id) or (c.target_type = 'media' and exists (select 1 from media cm where cm.id = c.target_id and cm.poi_id = p.id))) and c.review_status = 'pending') as pending_comment_count, (select count(1) from media m where m.poi_id = p.id) as media_count, (select count(1) from media m where m.poi_id = p.id and m.type = 'ugc') as ugc_count from poi p
and p.status = #{status}
and p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by p.id desc

select f.id, f.user_id, u.nickname, f.target_type, f.target_id, case when f.target_type = 'poi' then f.target_id when f.target_type = 'media' then m.poi_id else null end as related_poi_id, case when f.target_type = 'poi' then p.name when f.target_type = 'media' then concat('影像 #', f.target_id) else null end as target_name, f.create_time from favorite f left join `user` u on u.id = f.user_id left join poi p on f.target_type = 'poi' and p.id = f.target_id left join media m on f.target_type = 'media' and m.id = f.target_id order by f.create_time desc limit #{limit}

select f.id, f.user_id, u.nickname, f.target_type, f.target_id, case when f.target_type = 'poi' then f.target_id when f.target_type = 'media' then m.poi_id else null end as related_poi_id, case when f.target_type = 'poi' then p.name when f.target_type = 'media' then concat('影像 #', f.target_id) else null end as target_name, f.create_time from favorite f left join `user` u on u.id = f.user_id left join poi p on f.target_type = 'poi' and p.id = f.target_id left join media m on f.target_type = 'media' and m.id = f.target_id where (f.target_type = 'poi' and f.target_id in
#{id} ) or (f.target_type = 'media' and m.poi_id in
#{id} ) order by f.create_time desc

select c.id, c.user_id, u.nickname, c.target_type, c.target_id, case when c.target_type = 'poi' then c.target_id when c.target_type = 'media' then m.poi_id else null end as related_poi_id, case when c.target_type = 'poi' then p.name when c.target_type = 'media' then concat('影像 #', c.target_id) else null end as target_name, c.content, c.review_status, c.reject_reason, c.create_time from `comment` c left join `user` u on u.id = c.user_id left join poi p on c.target_type = 'poi' and p.id = c.target_id left join media m on c.target_type = 'media' and m.id = c.target_id where ((c.target_type = 'poi' and c.target_id in
#{id} ) or (c.target_type = 'media' and m.poi_id in
#{id} ))
and c.review_status = #{reviewStatus}
order by c.create_time desc
